title: 云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 七十八章 龙王云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 七十九章 逆鳞
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
林灵素道：“在那之前，我从没修炼过任何真气法门，只跟着张道士学过基本的守一吐纳。照着壁上的文字吐纳运气，竟觉得说不出的舒畅通泰，一连练了六个时辰，仍不觉得半点困倦，心中的惊喜振奋，言语难描万一。
“此后半个多月，我除了吃睡之外，就是按部就班地炼气修行。到了第十八天，那千余字的口诀已被我背得滚瓜烂熟。其中除了炼气心诀外，还有八十一路刀法、御气飞行的心得和数十种拆解金山寺‘伏魔杖法’的招式。
“我背完后犹觉不足，又将塔内的其他泥像、木佛一一敲碎、移开，果然又发现了十几幅刻在壁上的文字，共计九千余字，包罗万象，从青城剑术到龙虎丹药、灵宝符咒……几乎各门各派均有涉及。有些虽然只是只鳞片爪，浮于表面，但对于我来说，却已如瞬间开启了一扇门，进入见所未见的奇妙世界。”
众道士听得又惊又奇，都在猜想这“无名氏”究竟是何方神圣。萨守坚冷冷道：“我还以为李师伯有什么通天之能，能融会百家，修成各派心法，原来不过是拾人牙慧，从金山寺的囚犯那里盗过来的。”
林灵素哈哈一笑，道：“小子，你师尊没教过你‘一生二，二生三，三生万物’么？天下道法，师于自然，本来就是你中有我，我中有你。只要吃透阴阳五行，自然就能举一反三，触类旁通。你这个‘盗’字，用得忒也愚蠢。”
许宣脑中电光回闪，想起从前在药堂里听那些大夫所说的那些阴阳五行的道理，再与葛长庚所传的“翠虚金丹大法”相互映证，果然有许多相通之处，心中嘭嘭大跳，暗想：“炼烧外丹讲究的是水火相济，五行转换；翠虚金丹大法则是以炁为火，以体为炉，将五行变化为元婴内丹。说来说去果然只是‘五行生克、阴阳和谐’这八字，如能参透，或许便能一通百通。”
又想：“经脉脏腑皆分五行，如果能循五行相生之道，次第运转真气，不知会不会有助益？”
他从小耳濡目染，对各经脉的五行属性了如指掌，当下默念法诀，依照金生水、水生木、木生火、火生土、土生金的顺序，将真气在经络间循环周转。如此一来，真气果然环环激生，越发充沛。心里又惊又喜。
他原本就是聪明绝顶之人，无意间被林灵素这般一点拨，当即大有所悟。只此片刻，便在修行的境界上迈进了一大步。
黑暗中，又听林灵素说道：“我在塔里囚禁了一个月，戒律院的贼秃上门呵责，问我是否已悔过。我还没看完壁上文字，生怕他们将我放出，于是故意破口大骂，从小沙弥一直骂到如来佛祖、观音菩萨。那些贼秃大怒，说要加罚我禁闭三个月。嘿嘿，正中老子下怀。
“我在伏魔塔里待了四个月，终于将壁上所有文字全都记得烂熟于胸，真气也略有根基，那些专门克制伏魔杖法的招式更是练得似模似样。眼看囚期将尽，我将壁上所有字画都刮铲干净，只等着那些贼秃一开门，便杀他们个措手不及。
“那天夜里，我正挥舞着半截戒刀，练习壁上的刀法，忽然听见寺内钟声大作，‘嘭’地一声，厚近三寸的铁门竟突然撞飞，一道人影闪电似的冲了进来，一把将我抓起，低声喝问：‘小和尚，那幅图在哪里？’
“那声音清脆甜美，居然是个女子。我又惊又奇，正不知该答什么，戒律院的四个和尚已经冲到了，那女子回手连劈两掌，光轮怒舞，便将那几个贼秃立毙当场。
“塔外呼喝连声，和尚接二连三地冲来，刚一靠近，便被她长袖所化的气刀劈得东飞西撞。那是我平生第一次看见杀人，热血瞬间冲上了头顶，又是恐惧，又是兴奋。
“月光照在她的脸上，白的像雪，眼睛却如同两点碧绿的鬼火。我心想她必是女鬼，除了鬼，又有谁能使出这么诡异莫测的招法，所向披靡？
“周围的和尚越来越多，了尘方丈也握着禅杖御风飞来，站在慈寿塔上，高声道：‘苦海无边，回头是岸。女施主既知塔内所困何人，何不放下屠刀，立地成佛？’
“那女人冷笑道：‘老秃驴，你们害死我叔公，夺走宝物，还装什么慈悲，扮什么神佛？今日不交出图来，我便将你们的破庙烧得一干二净！’
“了尘方丈道：‘阿弥陀佛，原来你是九头龙王的后人。他住在敝寺塔内十六年，寿终正寝，何来加害之说？不知女施主所说的图又是何物？若是佛经禅卷，老衲可破例为你到藏经楼借出一观。’”
听到“九头龙王”四字，舱中众道士登时大哗，才知道他所说的“无名氏”竟然是魔门六十年前的阳极护法“九头龙王”敖无名。
此人妖法通天，凶狂跋扈，曾孤身独闯峨嵋、青城、龙虎三山，以一柄青螭逆鳞刀大败张天师、圆如方丈等十一位顶尖高手，并移山御石，撞断峨嵋中峰，又引来雷霆暴雨，水淹青城，凶焰一时无两。在他引领下，原本分崩离析的魔门空前团结，声威大震。后来又突然不知所踪，再无音讯，想不到竟是被困在金山寺的伏魔塔中。

林灵素道：“那时我压根不知道九头龙王是什么人物，但既学了他的本事，也算有师徒之缘。见这女人将这帮贼秃骂得面无人色，杀得屁滚尿流，心里说不出的痛快，再听说她是那无名氏的侄孙女，更觉亲切。只盼她大开杀戒，再一把火烧了这破寺，替我出口鸟气。
“那女人格格笑道：‘出家人不打诳语，老秃驴你睁着眼睛说瞎话，羞也不羞？我叔公被你关在这里十多年，你会不知道那图在哪里？’右臂朝上一振，光芒直冲夜穹。
“‘轰’地一声，雷电狂舞，随着她指尖所向，猛然劈落在藏经阁上，顶阁顿时窜起熊熊烈火。那些和尚惊呼大叫，全都朝藏经阁奔去。
“塔里石壁上所刻写的文字，曾记载如何用真炁引落雷霆，我只当是夸张之语，没想到竟真有此事，那时亲眼目睹，更是说不出的震撼。
“金山寺所藏经书种类之多、版本之罕，号称天下第一，其中不少是唐三藏从西域带回、亲手翻译的抄本，被她这般引雷烧着，简直是要了这帮贼秃的命。了尘那老和尚也按捺不住了，凌空冲来，禅杖飞舞。
“那女子大笑道：‘老贼秃，你又是偷又是嗔又是妄语，还要再犯杀戒么？’突然将我飞甩而出。
“了尘吃了一惊，急忙将禅杖朝外收卷。但那时我与他相距已不过丈许，他冲势又极快，眼见禅杖朝我头顶撞来，我突然想起敖无名刻在壁上的破解招式，鬼使神差地向外一转，半截戒刀疾刺而出。
“敖无名在塔里十六年，日日夜夜都在想着对付伏魔杖法，这一刀叫做‘龙抬头’。了尘的修为远不如当年的照影、佛印，这一下又相距甚近，猝不及防，顿时被我一刀刺没胸膛，鲜血瞬间溅了我一脸。
“他惊讶地看着我，左手紧紧地抓住我的肩膀，我也呆住了。这老和尚虽然有点儿假慈悲，待我却总算不错，莫名其妙地死在老子手里，真他奶奶的冤枉。周围的贼秃又惊又怒，纷纷大叫：‘这小贼刺死了方丈，抓住他，莫让他跑了！’
“刚从半空摔落在地，几个秃驴便围冲而来，戒棒劈头盖脑地打落。性命攸关，我挥扫戒刀，将这几个月里所学的破解佛魔杖的招式全都使了出来。嘿嘿，那些贼秃又哪能想到士别三日，我进境如斯？惊呼惨叫，转眼间便被我砍断双腿，劈成重伤。
“这一来那帮贼秃更是炸了锅啦，认定老子是那女人派来的奸细，混进金山寺，就是为了刺杀方丈，盗取经书，无不潮水似的朝我扑来。那女人一把将我提起，腾云驾雾地朝大江上游掠去。
“四周火焰冲天，人影晃动，那些秃驴前赴后继地上前拦阻，全都被她杀得落花流水。
“那女人飞速极快，叱呵声越来越远，过不多久，耳边只能听见呼呼的风声。回头望去，江水滔滔，山势连绵，金山寺已经看不见了。她拎着我又奔掠了一刻来钟，才在山顶停了下来，笑吟吟地问我：‘小和尚，你这“逆鳞刀法”是从哪里学来的？’
“我原想和盘托出，转念又想，她自称是敖无名的侄孙女，也不知是真是假，如果只是冒名来盗取无名氏的遗图，我说出后，多半要被她杀了灭口。嘿嘿，那时我以为她口口声声所说的‘图’是敖无名刻在壁上的字画，又岂会料到竟是这幅上古流传下来的‘青龙皮图’？”
众人虽已隐隐猜到，听他这般道破，仍忍不住心中一跳。

content_en:
Lin Lingsu said: "Before that, I had never practiced any Zhenqi method. I only learned the basic Shouyi Tuna from Taoist Zhang. When I breathed out my luck according to the words on the wall, I felt indescribably comfortable and peaceful. I practiced for six hours in a row, and I still didn't feel sleepy at all. The surprise and excitement in my heart were hard to describe in words.
"For more than half a month after that, apart from eating and sleeping, I practiced Qi step by step. By the eighteenth day, I had memorized the more than a thousand words of formula by heart. In addition to the Qi Refining Heart Technique, there are also eighty-one sword techniques, the experience of controlling Qi and flying, and dozens of moves to dismantle Jinshan Temple's "Magic Subduing Wand Technique".
"After memorizing it, I still felt that it was not enough, so I smashed and removed the other clay statues and wooden Buddhas in the pagoda one by one. Sure enough, I found more than a dozen words carved on the wall, totaling more than 9,000 words, covering everything from Qingcheng swordsmanship to dragon and tiger elixirs, spiritual treasure charms... almost all sects involved. Although some of them are just scales and claws, floating on the surface, for me, it is like a door has been opened instantly, entering a wonderful world I have never seen before."
All the Taoist priests were surprised and surprised when they heard this, and they were all wondering who this "Anonymous" was. Sa Shojian said coldly: "I thought that Master Li had some extraordinary ability, that he could integrate hundreds of schools of thought and cultivate the mental methods of each school. It turned out that he just stole it from the prisoners of Jinshan Temple by picking up people's wisdom."
Lin Lingsu laughed and said, "Boy, didn't your master teach you that 'two is born, two begets three, and three begets all things'? Taoism in the world is based on nature. It is originally you who have me, and I have you. As long as you have a thorough understanding of yin and yang and the five elements, you will naturally be able to draw inferences and draw parallels. You use the word 'thief' too stupidly."
Xu Xuan's brain flashed back, and he remembered the principles of Yin and Yang and the Five Elements that he had heard from the doctors in the medicine hall, and then compared them with the "Cuixu Golden Elixir" taught by Ge Changgeng. Sure enough, there were many similarities. His heart jumped loudly, and he thought to himself: "Lian Shao Waidan" What is emphasized is the harmony of water and fire, and the transformation of the five elements; the principle of Cuixu Golden Pill is to use Qi as fire, use the body as the furnace, and transform the five elements into Yuanying inner elixir. After all, it is just the eight characters of "the five elements are in harmony, and the yin and yang are in harmony." If you can understand it, you may be able to understand everything. "
He also thought: "The meridians and internal organs are all divided into five elements. If we can follow the path of the five elements' mutual development and circulate the true energy in sequence, will it be helpful?"
He has been exposed to it since he was a child and knows the five elements attributes of each meridians very well. He recites the formula silently and circulates the true energy among the meridians in the order of metal generating water, water generating wood, wood generating fire, fire generating earth, and earth generating metal. In this way, the true energy is indeed stimulated and becomes more abundant. I was surprised and happy.
He was originally a very smart person, but when he was accidentally nudged by Lin Lingsu, he immediately realized something. In just this moment, he has taken a big step forward in the realm of spiritual practice.
In the darkness, I heard Lin Lingsu say again: "I was imprisoned in the pagoda for a month. The thief from the Discipline Academy came to scold me and asked me if I had repented. I hadn't read the words on the wall, and I was afraid that they would release me, so I deliberately cursed, from the young novice to Tathagata Buddha and Guanyin Bodhisattva. The thief Bald was furious and said that they would punish me for an additional three months of confinement. Hehe, it played into my heart.
"I stayed in the Demon-Subduing Tower for four months, and finally I knew all the words on the wall by heart. I also had a basic foundation in Qi, and I had practiced the moves specifically designed to restrain the Demon-Subduing Wand. Seeing that my prison term was coming to an end, I scraped away all the calligraphy and paintings on the walls, just waiting for those thieves to open the door and kill them by surprise.
"That night, I was wielding the half-cut sword and practicing the sword skills on the wall. Suddenly I heard the bell in the temple ringing loudly, and with a bang, the nearly three-inch-thick iron door suddenly flew away. A figure rushed in like lightning, grabbed me, and asked in a low voice: 'Little monk, where is that picture?'
"The voice is crisp and sweet,It's a woman. I was shocked and surprised, and just when I didn't know what to answer, four monks from the Discipline Academy had already rushed over. The woman struck back with two palms, her halo danced angrily, and she killed the thieves on the spot.
"There were shouts from outside the tower, and the monks rushed towards me one after another. As soon as they got close, they were hit by the air knife transformed from her long sleeves. That was the first time in my life that I saw a murderer. The blood rushed to the top of my head in an instant, and I was filled with fear and excitement.
"The moonlight shone on her face, which was as white as snow, but her eyes were like two green will-o'-the-wisps. I thought she must be a female ghost. Besides ghosts, who else could use such weird and unpredictable tricks to be invincible?
"There were more and more monks around. Abbot Liao Chen also held a Zen staff and flew towards the wind. He stood on the Cishou Pagoda and said loudly: 'The sea of suffering is boundless, and there is a shore when you turn around. Since the female donor knew who was trapped in the tower, why didn't she put down her butcher knife and become a Buddha immediately?'
"The woman sneered and said: 'Old bald donkey, you killed my uncle and took away the treasures, how can you pretend to be compassionate or pretend to be gods and Buddhas? If you don’t hand over the map today, I will burn your ruined temple to the ground! ’
"Abbot Liaochen said: 'Amitabha, it turns out that you are a descendant of the Nine-Headed Dragon King. He lived in the pagoda of our temple for sixteen years and died at the end of his life. How can he do harm? I wonder what the picture the female donor is talking about is? If it is a Buddhist scripture scroll, I can make an exception and lend it to you at the Sutra Library.'"
Hearing the words "Nine-Headed Dragon King", all the Taoist priests in the cabin immediately burst into an uproar, only to realize that the "Anonymous" he was talking about was actually the "Nine-Headed Dragon King" Ao Wuming, the anode protector of the Demon Sect sixty years ago.
This demon has powerful magic and is fierce and domineering. He once braved Emei, Qingcheng, and Longhu Mountains alone. He defeated eleven top masters such as Zhang Tianshi and Yuanru Fangzhang with a Qing Chi scale-reverse sword. He also moved mountains and stones, broke the middle peak of Emei, and caused thunderstorms, flooding Qingcheng, and fierce flames. Under his leadership, the originally disintegrated Demon Sect was united like never before and its prestige was astonishing. Later, he suddenly disappeared and was never heard from again. Unexpectedly, he was trapped in the Demon-Conquering Pagoda of Jinshan Temple.
Lin Lingsu said: "At that time, I didn't know who the Nine-Headed Dragon King was at all, but since I learned his skills, I was considered a master and disciple. Seeing this woman scolding these thieves until they turned pale, I felt indescribable joy in my heart. And then I heard that she was the grandniece of the unknown person, and I felt even more intimate. I just hope that she will go on a killing spree, burn this ruined temple again, and vent her anger on me.
"The woman giggled and said: 'Monks don't tell lies. Old bald donkey, you tell lies with your eyes open. Are you ashamed? My uncle has been locked up here for more than ten years. Don't you know where that picture is? ’ He raised his right arm, and the light shot straight into the night sky.
"With a 'boom' sound, thunder and lightning danced wildly, following the direction of her fingertips, and suddenly struck the Sutra Pavilion, and the top pavilion suddenly burst into flames. The monks screamed and ran towards the Sutra Pavilion.
"The words carved on the stone wall of the tower once recorded how to use true energy to draw down thunder. I only thought it was an exaggeration. I didn't expect it to actually happen. When I saw it with my own eyes, I was shocked beyond words.
"The variety and rare editions of scriptures collected by Jinshan Temple are said to be the best in the world. Many of them are manuscripts brought back by Tang Sanzang from the Western Regions and translated by his own hands. Being set on fire by her like this would kill these thieves. The old monk Liaochen couldn't hold himself back anymore. He rushed over in the air with his Zen staff flying.
"The woman laughed and said: 'Old thief Bald, you have stolen, been angry and lied, do you want to commit murder again? ’ Suddenly I was thrown away.
"Liao Chen was startled and hurriedly rolled the Zen staff outward. But at that time, I was only a few feet away from him, and he was charging very fast. When I saw the Zen staff hitting my head, I suddenly remembered Ao Wuming's cracking move carved on the wall. I turned outward by mistake, and stabbed out half of the sword.
"Ao Wuming has been in the tower for sixteen years. Day and night, he has been thinking about how to deal with the magic wand. This sword is called 'Dragon'."look up'. Liao Chen's cultivation was far inferior to that of Zhaoying and Buddha Seal back then, and now they were so close that he was caught off guard. He was stabbed in the chest by me, and blood instantly splashed all over my face.
"He looked at me in surprise, and held my shoulder tightly with his left hand. I was also stunned. Although this old monk was a little fake-compassionate, he treated me well. He died inexplicably in my hands. His grandmother was unjust. The thief bald around me was shocked and angry, and they all shouted: 'This little thief stabbed the abbot to death, catch him, don't let him escape!'
"As soon as he fell to the ground from mid-air, several bald donkeys rushed towards him and knocked down the sword on his head. My life was at stake, so I swung my sword and used all the tricks I had learned in the past few months to break the Buddha's magic wand. Hey, how could those bald thieves have thought that I would be like this after leaving the country for three days? I screamed and screamed, and in the blink of an eye, my legs were cut off and severely injured.
"The gang of thieves were even more upset now. They decided that I was a spy sent by that woman, who had sneaked into Jinshan Temple in order to assassinate the abbot and steal the scriptures. They all rushed towards me like a tide. The woman lifted me up and swept me up the river in the clouds and mist.
"The flames were rising all around, and the figures were shaking. The bald donkeys stepped forward one after another to stop her, but they were all killed by her.
"The woman was flying very fast, and her screams were getting farther and farther. After a while, all I could hear was the whistling of the wind. Looking back, I saw the surging river, the rolling hills, and the Jinshan Temple was no longer visible. She carried me and ran for another quarter of an hour before stopping at the top of the mountain. She asked me with a smile: 'Little monk, where did you learn the "Reverse Scale Sword Technique"?'
"I originally wanted to tell the truth, but then I thought about it. She claimed to be Ao Wuming's grand-niece. I don't know if it was true or not. If she just pretended to be Ao Wuming to steal Wuming's remains, she would probably kill me after I told her. Hehe, at that time I thought that the 'picture' she kept talking about was the calligraphy and painting carved on the wall by Ao Wuming. How could I have expected that it was actually the 'Blue Dragon Skin Picture' handed down from ancient times? "
Although everyone had vaguely guessed it, they still couldn't help but feel their hearts skip a beat when they heard his explanation.
